role: Manual mutation-testing harness (not in make ci or any workflow; ci.yml only comments on it) that applies 125 targeted source mutations one at a time, requiring the named XCTest class to go red for each. Every anchor's original text is present in the current tree (check_no_leaked_mutations.sh).
toplevel: set -uo pipefail; cd to repo root; sources preflight. PASS/FAIL/SKIP/INVALID counters. DEST from select_simulator_destination.sh (exit 70 if empty). gate_mktemp_dir (fails on GNU mktemp), then acquire lock and set trap restore_all/rm/release. Runs `mutate` for each of 125 cases (anchors match the current sources; six were re-pointed after the code they named was rewritten: dfa_ectopic_threshold_widened / dfa_cleans_normal_variation replace `let ectopicRatio = HRVThresholds.ectopicThresholdPercent` with 0.50 / 0.05 (LiveDFAAnalyzerTests' 30 % and 8 % cases), normalized_power_not_fourth_power squares in the `windowMeans.reduce` and normalized_power_window_shrunk divides the 30-sample window sum by 10 (NormalizedPowerTests' exact NP values), stored_hr_fabricates_a_sentinel returns statistics(of: [60]) from storedHRStatistics' guard (TimeDomainTests.testAllStoredHRArtifactsFallsBackToTheBeatsNotASentinel), ppi_timeline_does_not_advance stops `beatMs` advancing (StrapPPIFilterTests' [0, 800, 1620] timeline); two named suites (AutoPauseDetectorTests, TrackBackupWatermarkTests) are classes inside WorkoutTickStateTests.swift). import_cadence_divides_by_zero_window removes the `seconds > 0` window check (keeping `sample.value >= 0`), which compiles and is caught by the backwards-window assertion in HealthWorkoutImporterTests.testZeroLengthWindowIsDroppedRatherThanDividedByZero; the zero-length window itself stays covered by the later isFinite guard. Prints totals (caught / survived / did not compile / skipped); exits 1 if any FAIL, INVALID or SKIP (skips and non-compiling mutations explicitly treated as unverified).

units.does: Copies file $1 into the backup dir ('/'->'_' name) and adds it to TOUCHED.
Copies each TOUCHED file's backup back over it and clears TOUCHED.
units.entry: also called from the EXIT/INT/TERM/HUP trap

branches.effect: skip; otherwise cp (a missing backup makes cp fail silently, file left as is)

units.does: Runs `xcodebuild test -only-testing:<suite> -parallel-testing-enabled NO` into run.log; returns 0 on success, 2 if the log has BUILD/TEST BUILD FAILED or 'error: Building|Failed to' or contains no 'Test Suite'/'Test Case' line, else 1.

branches.cond: build-failure marker or no test ran

units.does: Baseline check for one mutation: run_suite on the suite, one retry when the result is 2 (build failed); returns 0 if green, else prints SKIP ('BUILD failed (not a test result)' for 2, '<suite> was already red' for 1), increments SKIP and returns 1.

branches.effect: print SKIP 'BUILD failed'; else print SKIP 'already red'; then SKIP++ and return 1

units.does: Returns 0 if the last run.log has a compiler diagnostic `<path>:<line>:<col>: error:` whose path ends in `/<file>` (the mutated file, repo-relative), i.e. the mutation itself did not compile; else 1.

Runs the suite with the mutation applied and echoes the verdict code: 1 = tests failed (caught), 0 = tests passed (survived), 3 = build failed with a compile error in the mutated file, 2 = build/runner failed for another reason on both attempts. A run_suite 2 without an error in the mutated file is retried once. Called in a command substitution, so it echoes rather than sets globals.

branches.cond: code == 2 and the mutated file has no compile error
code == 2 and the mutated file has a compile error

units.does: Prints the result line for one mutation and bumps its counter: 1 -> PASS 'caught it' (PASS++); 0 -> FAIL 'SURVIVED' (FAIL++); 3 -> FAIL 'the mutation does not compile — fix the mutation' (INVALID++); anything else -> SKIP 'BUILD failed after the mutation (not a test result)' (SKIP++).

branches.effect: INVALID++ (mutation did not compile; fails the run)
SKIP++ (build failure, not a test result; fails the run)

units.does: Runs one mutation: FILTER check; baseline_green (returns early when the suite is not green, already counted as SKIP); backup the file and apply the python mutation (SKIP on failure); mutated_result for the verdict; restore; report_mutation. Only a test failure (run_suite 1) counts as caught — a build failure after the mutation is INVALID (compile error in the mutated file) or SKIP (other build failure), never PASS.

branches.cond: FILTER set and not in name
